_comment: Routing-coupling map for check-skill-receipt.mjs (ADR-0038). policy-as-data: when a change touches a surface, the coupled skill(s) MUST be marked `applied` in the receipt, never `not-applicable`. This removes the escape of marking everything not-applicable. It is a STARTER map (spec decision 8d); each gap found later becomes one more rule here. The gate only FORCES applied on a firing surface; it never forbids marking an un-fired skill applied. Globs are generic so an adopter repo inherits sensible defaults; `when` is matched against the change's changed-file list (passed via --changed-list, computed from the PR diff in CI).
